## SESSION 3 UPDATE (2026-07-17): wave-2 — catalog 334 → 544 (+210 verified)

Ran `assets/prompts/visual-factory-wave2.md` unsupervised from 06:30. ~25 authors
across 4 shard territories × disjoint sub-niches; every asset validated on the live
canvas AND eyeballed on a contact sheet before promotion.

**New ground opened (the brief asked for exploration over exploitation):**

  `stairwell`, `colonnade`, `street_canyon`, `subway`, `library_stacks`,

- **Material** — `agate`, `damascus`, `wood_grain`, `brushed_metal`, `encaustic`,

- **Geomorphology** — `hydraulic_erosion`, `meander`, `delta_lobe`, `braided`,
  `karst`, `glacier`, `scree`, `stratigraphy`, `lava_lake`.
- **Instrument/signal** — `radar_ppi`, `helicorder`, `eeg_montage`, `synoptic_chart`,
  `gear_train`, `escapement`, `linkage`, `spaceframe`, `orthographic`, `jacquard`.
- **Materials-science pattern** — `spinodal`, `grain_growth`, `ostwald_ripening`,

- **Fluids/optics beyond the existing RD pieces** — `lic_flow`, `viscous_fingering`,

- **Solar/plasma** — `coronal_rain`, `spicules`, `sunspot`, `mhd_filaments`.

**Root cause found & fixed:** the ref-kernel integer hash finalized with an
arithmetic shift, capping every derived noise field at **half amplitude, biased
dark** (measured mean 0.2501 / max 0.5000 vs 0.5007 / 1.0000 fixed). See
`assets/visual/FACTORY_STATE.md` § ROOT CAUSE. This is very likely what SESSION 2
was treating symptomatically when it hand-"brightened" `blackhole`,
`constellations`, `plasma_warp` and `caustics` — **21 verified assets still carry
the buggy copy and were deliberately left alone** (blindly fixing them would now
over-brighten the hand-compensated ones).

**Honest gap:** the stretch target was ~1000; we reached 544. The constraint was
authoring throughput (~1 asset / 4–5 min / author), not the canvas. Add authors.

1. **Cosmic** — nbody galaxy + starfield_warp(60) + gumowski_mira(45)
2. **Geometric** — moebius_grid + celtic_knot(45) + matrix_rain(40)

(Snapshots in `scratchpad/gf/_vj/`.) Additive / dark-ground pieces layer best; opaque-paper pieces (watercolor, fractal_tree) work as bases.

- **Process notes:** subagent hit-rate ~85–90% when judged on-canvas in color; the recurring failure modes were (1) dead-black-space / too-dark, (2) motion re-phasing at the 8 s window (single-frequency animation — always drive motion with real-time K.t at incommensurate rates), (3) effects too faint/sparse. All are now baked into author-brief guidance.
